scope: Mechanistic propagation through the frozen odor/wind goal-channel candidate into PFL outputs. This protocol does not test heading comparison, DNa02 turning, or behavioral navigation.

primary_model_semantics.description: FB5AB context gates expression/transmission of the PFN-derived hDeltaC wind representation. This follows the Matheson et al. modeling abstraction and must not be described as measured axo-axonic physiology in MaleCNS.

descriptive_model_comparators.name: additive_FB5AB_ACh
descriptive_model_comparators.description: Treat predicted cholinergic FB5AB structural input as additive modeled drive rather than a gate. Report only as a mechanistic sensitivity comparison; it cannot replace the preregistered primary gate model based on task performance.

descriptive_model_comparators.name: hDeltaM_relay
descriptive_model_comparators.description: Use the frozen hDeltaM structural comparator in place of hDeltaG. This comparator cannot rescue or replace hDeltaG if downstream performance is better.

input_semantics: Probe inputs are abstract mechanistic perturbations. They must not be labeled physical wind direction, left wind, right wind, odor concentration, or source location until a separate sensory/topography mapping is sealed.

fixed_gates.name: authority_hashes_match
fixed_gates.criterion: All structural, sign, and topography inputs match their sealed hashes.

fixed_gates.name: no_behavioral_oracle_inputs
fixed_gates.criterion: No source coordinates, culprit identity, distance-to-source, plume image, reward, or behavioral success signal is available to the mechanistic graph.

fixed_gates.name: deterministic_replay
fixed_gates.criterion: Identical graph, perturbation, seed, and drive sequence reproduce modeled state exactly within 1e-12.

fixed_gates.name: primary_route_hDeltaC_cut
fixed_gates.criterion: Within the restricted primary route, removing hDeltaC output abolishes downstream hDeltaG/PFL propagation from PFN probes.

fixed_gates.name: primary_route_hDeltaG_cut
fixed_gates.criterion: Within the restricted primary route, removing hDeltaG output abolishes PFL propagation from upstream probes.

fixed_gates.name: odor_gate_negative_control
fixed_gates.criterion: Under the preregistered gate model, PFN probe transmission through the odor-gated hDeltaC output is suppressed when the context gate is off.

mandatory_reports_not_pass_thresholds: response amplitude for each structural threshold 1/3/5/10
forbidden_selection: Do not choose a structural threshold because it gives the best downstream response.
Do not replace hDeltaG with hDeltaM because hDeltaM performs better.
Do not infer a wind direction from anatomical column number or somaSide.
Do not tune the gate strength using behavioral success.
Do not call PFL activity a steering command until the heading channel is independently integrated.
claim_boundary: Passing E002b would qualify deterministic modeled propagation through a restricted, signed candidate goal channel under explicit literature-constrained gating assumptions. It would not qualify sensory tuning, heading comparison, physiological firing, steering direction, source finding, or intact-versus-rewire behavioral performance.
